meaning: MAINLINE PLAY-state code. STATE == 0 takes the IFEQ arm and dispatches to the PLAY handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-525). Hex 0 under W3COMN.MAC's inherited .RADIX 16.

MAINLINE PAUSE-state code. Hex 80 sets the high bit, so as a signed byte STATE < 0 and MAINLINE's IFMI (branch-on-minus) dispatches to the PAUSE handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-525). The hex reading is forced by that sign test; decimal 80 would still be positive and dispatch down the SETUP branch.

MAINLINE SETUP-state code. Hex 40 > 0 with the high bit clear, so STATE > 0 takes MAINLINE's ELSE arm to the SETUP handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-525); the cold start writes it to STATE (W3MAIN.MAC:491 LDA I,S.SETU). Hex 40 under .RADIX 16.

Cold start: power-up loads S.SETU (W3MAIN.MAC:491 LDA I,S.SETU) and stores it to STATE (:493 STA STATE), so the cabinet boots into the SETUP state. It also seeds SETUPC=CPRGM1 (:487-489), and CPRGM1's SETUP task PREGM1 clears ATRACT to attract mode (:3761 STA ATRACT ;ATTRACT MODE — the ATRACT byte is the ;ATTRACT (0)/GAME (-1) FLAG, :135). So the machine comes up in SETUP/attract, not play. This is the boot state mc6-4 wires; mc6-2 files the S.SETU anchor.

The first SETUP task is NEWGAM, reached through the SETUP1 task-address list — SETUP1: .WORD NEWGAM-1 (W3MAIN.MAC:583) -> NEWGAM (:3835). NEWGAM seeds a fresh game on wave 1 (LDA I,1 / STA WAVENO), the reseed mc6-2's startGame performs. The -1 is the ROM's RTS-vector convention (address minus one, pushed for an RTS dispatch).

Maximum radius of the game-over 'final bang' explosion (ENDGM2, W3MAIN.MAC:4683, reached via the .WORD ENDGM2-1 SETUP entry :601). ENDGM2 grows the death explosion from ENDUPD up to ENDMAX and shrinks it back to 0 at ENDUPD dots/frame before handing to the attract/DISPLAY-5-HI screen (SETUPC=CDLADR), so that grow+shrink span (2*ENDMAX/ENDUPD frames) is the post-game-over hold. mc6-6 derives OVER_TIMEOUT_FRAMES (state.ts) from it — the over->attract MAINLINE-loop timeout. Hex forced: 'THE END' displays at CMP I,62 (:4713), which must be < ENDMAX to ever fire — 0x62=98 < 0x6D=109; a decimal 6 makes 'THE END' unreachable. Hex 6D=109 under W3COMN.MAC's inherited .RADIX 16.
